title: Narbai
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yochanan ben Narbai, High Priest; [Pesachim 57a](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.57a.10-11). And in [Keritot 28a](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.28a.32) the reading is Yochanan ben Nadbai.[^1]

notes.text: Pesachim reads Narbai and Keritot reads Nadbai in the parallel story about Yochanan and his consumption of sacrificial food. The identification of his office as High Priest is Hyman’s.
